segments.text: Ok so this is the Open Generative UI page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, umm, it says generated code runs in a sandboxed iframe, but that iframe never shows up.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. It should render a small dashboard filter in the chat, but nothing renders, just text from the agent.
So basically, with the provider config from the page, no sandboxed UI ever appears.
The page doesn't show any other step that's needed.
So umm, this one needs fixing, please look into it.
